build_image_classification_dataset: create an ImageClassificationPreprocessor to validate and prepare image classification data for training
build_object_detection_dataset: create an ObjectDetectionPreprocessor to validate metadata and prepare object detection data for training
build_image_regression_dataset: create an ImageRegressionPreprocessor to validate metadata and prepare image regression data for training
split_image_classification_data: use ImageClassificationPreprocessor split method to stratify a dataframe into train and validation sets
process_object_detection_metadata: use ObjectDetectionPreprocessor _process_metadata to extract file names, bounding boxes, and categories from metadata.jsonl
